name: reaction-bar
title: Reaction bar
description: Emoji reactions under a message or comment: counts, your own pressed, who reacted on hover, and an add button with a palette you walk with arrow keys.
docs: Keep reactions in state and update it in onToggle (applyReaction does the bookkeeping). The bar shows your press at once; if onToggle rejects it puts the count back and says so in words, and a request in flight blocks a second press on the same emoji. users lists the other people who reacted, so the tooltip can read 'You, Ana Reyes and 2 others'; it may hold only the first few names. max is the most different reactions one message can carry. disabled makes the bar read only: the chips keep full contrast, their tooltip and their place in the tab order (they are aria-disabled, not disabled) and only the add button is dimmed.
